0022600123.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (0-3, 14th in the East, 5th in the Central and 2.5 games back) host the Indiana Pacers (1-1, 9th in the East, 3rd in the Central and 1 game back) in the Bucks' fourth game of the 2026-27 season, and Milwaukee is still looking for its first win. Indiana is missing Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery) and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), all listed as out. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Bucks won the 2025-26 series 4-0, most recently 134-123 in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026.
